description: A structure satisfies a row problem exactly when the truth value of every atom in its finite support agrees with the specified Boolean row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L))
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L → Bool) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Satisfies
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem S b) M ↔
    ∀ a ∈ S, a.Realize M ↔ b a = true
